ata.title: Forward Fuselage Wiring — Cargo Compartment Wiring

abstract: Wiring diagram sheet for the forward cargo compartment, showing the lower shell cable route between the two compartments, the ground point positions and the support bracket stations along the longitudinal joint.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the forward cargo compartment wiring, including the lower shell cable route, the ground points and the support brackets, for all ZEPHYR-22 family aircraft.
sections.sheet_note: The route is drawn looking outboard on the left side; the right side is a mirror image with the same harness references and a different ground point at station 1240. Wire numbers on the sheet are the aircraft-level references and do not change with the cabin configuration. The support brackets shown between stations 1080 and 1360 are attached to the lower shell longitudinal joint and are the reason this route has to be considered whenever that joint is opened. Connector contact allocation is on sheet 2.
sections.routing_note: The harness leaves the avionics bay at the forward pressure bulkhead penetration, runs aft along the lower shell above the cargo floor line through zones 113 and 121, and terminates at the aft cargo compartment junction. It is supported at eight bracket stations, four of which land on the longitudinal joint fastener line. Minimum separation from the cargo floor drain path is 40 millimetres. The route must be re-supported, not simply re-clipped, if any bracket station is removed during structural work.
